manualPp.title: Map difficulty and PP calculation
manualPp.ratingDescription: A numeric measure of each song's typing difficulty, calculated from KPM and character diversity.
manualPp.ppDescription: Points calculated from your play results. Accuracy, clear rate, speed, and difficulty are all taken into account.
manualPp.ppCaveat: * Results on maps that were updated after the first PP calculation (before 2026-4-22) have an unknown rating, so they are set to 0pp.

kpm.title: Calculating KPM
kpm.body: Calculates the romaji KPM (Keys Per Minute) of each line. Lines above 1700 KPM are excluded as outliers.
kpm.formula: KPM = (notes in the line ÷ line duration) × 60

diversity.title: Character diversity score (Diversity)
diversity.body: Evaluates the character distribution of the words in each line with Shannon entropy and produces a diversity score from 0 to 1. Lines that repeat the same character, such as "aaa…", score lower.
diversity.formula:
diversity = H(character distribution) / log₂(character count)
* All characters the same → 0, all different → close to 1

penalty.title: Applying the diversity penalty
penalty.body: For lines whose diversity score is below the threshold (0.6), KPM is attenuated exponentially. This corrects the difficulty of lines with a lot of repeated characters.
penalty.formula:
diversity ≥ 0.6  →  no penalty (× 1.0)
diversity < 0.6  →  adjustedKPM = KPM × (diversity / 0.6)²

score.title: Calculating the difficulty score (difficultyScore)
score.body: Combines the notes-weighted average KPM with the average of the top 2 lines by adjusted KPM (peak KPM) at a 7:3 ratio to get the difficulty score.
score.formula:
avgKPM  = Σ(adjustedKPM × share of notes)
peakKPM = average adjustedKPM of the top 2 lines
difficultyScore = avgKPM × 0.7 + peakKPM × 0.3

notes.title: Note count correction
notes.body: Corrects on a logarithmic scale around a total of 270 notes. Songs with fewer notes are adjusted down and songs with more notes up (capped at ×1.1).

final.title: Difficulty
final.body: Divides the difficulty score by 100 and multiplies by the note correction to get the final difficulty.

base.title: Base PP
base.body: Calculates the base PP from the difficulty. rating: difficulty

clearRate.title: Clear rate correction
clearRate.body1: Starting from 100%, subtracts according to the number of misses and missed notes. Kana input is also calculated in romaji equivalents.
clearRate.legend1: totalNotes: total romaji notes, missCount: misses, lostNotes: missed notes, keyRate: 100/totalNotes, missRate: half of keyRate
clearRate.formula1:
keyRate  = 100 / totalNotes
missRate = keyRate / 2

clearRate = 100 − missCount × missRate − lostNotes × keyRate
clearRate.body2: Corrects by raising the clear rate to a power. The higher the difficulty, the smaller the exponent, so PP is easier to earn even with a low clear rate.
clearRate.legend2: clearRate: clear rate, exp: correction exponent
clearRate.formula2:
exp = 1.2 + 1.0 / (1 + rating / 8)
  rating=0  → exp≈2.2
  rating=5  → exp≈1.7
  rating=10 → exp≈1.53

correction = clearRate ^ exp

accuracy.title: Accuracy correction
accuracy.body: Calculates accuracy as successful keystrokes ÷ (keystrokes + misses) and squares it. The lower the accuracy, the more PP drops.
accuracy.legend: accuracy: accuracy, type: keystrokes, miss: misses

speed.title: Speed correction
speed.body: The correction rises at playback speeds of 1.0 or higher, up to a maximum of 1.5x. (Speeds below 1.0 cannot be registered to the ranking.)

raw.title: PP of a map result
raw.body: Calculates the PP of each score.

total.title: Total PP for the skill ranking
total.body: Picks the top 200 scores by PP and sums them with a decay of 0.95 per rank. The best score contributes the most, and contributions shrink as the rank goes down.
